name: pi-health
description: Pi-native health checks and diagnostics toolkit for pi.dev extensions: deterministic readiness/liveness probes, pass/warn/fail check results, package/config/dependency/filesystem checks, optional bounded URL probes, and Markdown/JSON status reports.
